name: Glasshand
summary: Rents a dedicated real iPhone or Mac in a data center so your AI agent can use it like you would, then wipes the device.
description: Glasshand rents physical iPhones and Macs, hosted in its data center, to AI agents. You connect Claude Code, Codex or another agent and it can rent a device with a prompt, then use it for tasks such as posting on TikTok, booking an Uber, or building and testing iOS apps. Each device is yours alone for the rental period; when you are done, Glasshand says it erases your data and factory-resets the hardware.
features: Dedicated real iPhone or Mac rental
works with Claude Code, Codex and other agents
data wipe and factory reset at the end
